Commentary.Commentary: This is when Moises Henriques stepped up scoring his maiden T20I fifty with a healthy strike rate of 151.35. Coming to the Sri Lankan bowlers, all of them chipped in with wickets except Munaweera who leaked 22 runs in his only over. With 174 to chase, it seems like this match will be closely fought given that the visitors have opted for an extra batsman in the form of Kusal Mendis. Do join us for the chase in a bit.

Early in the innings, it was Vikum Sanjaya who created doubts in the minds of Australia's batsmen as he made full use of the pitch extracting extra bounce to dismiss the opposition captain Aaron Finch just for 12 runs. Michael Klinger played well like he did at the MCG, but he was never able to accelerate. He actually ended up consuming 37 balls for his 43.

Lasith Malinga's return to the side seems to have created some competition in the Sri Lankan bowling line-up as yorkers were the mantra of the night. One ball after another, they kept coming as Australia slumped from 134/5 to 173 all out. How often do you see six wickets tumbling in the last five overs. Despite the collapse, the hosts still managed to score 48 runs off the last five overs.

OUT! You miss, I hit! Fuller and into the stumps, Richardson looks to go over mid-wicket, bending his knee, he misses and is bowled. A golden duck on debut for Jhye. That's career best figures for Nuwan Kulasekara, 4-0-31-4! AUSTRALIA BOWLED OUT FOR 173!
The debutant Jhye Richardson arrives at the centre.

OUT! Another one falls! Hurls it on the stumps, Tye looks to clip it through mid-wicket but misses. He is rapped on the pads and the bowler goes up in an appeal and the umpire obliges. Handy wickets for the visitors.
FOUR Leg Byes! Easy pickings! Fuller and angling down leg, Tye manages to tickle it down to fine leg. Lasith gives it a chase from short fine leg but cannot get to it despite the dive.
Andrew Tye comes out in the middle.

OUT! If Malinga can do it, so can I, says Nuwan! Bowls this one on the stumps, Pat is hit on his toes and the ball then deflects it onto the stumps. Nuwan is pumped up and why not, Sri Lanka have come back well in the game one thinks.
Fuller again, hit towards cover-point by Moises for a single. An inch wide and it was a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, hit down to long on for a couple of runs. Sri Lanka need to get the fielders to come in hard when the ball is not hit in the air towards them.
Nuwan Kulasekara to bowl the final over of the match.
Low dipping yorker on the stumps, Cummins just about gets his bat down and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Moises gets it towards point for a single.

Another of the yorkers from Malinga on the stumps, Pat had no clue about it. He gets it towards short extra cover with an angled bat. Malinga goes after it, fields it and fires it at the non-striker's end but misses. That was close!
Pat Cummins is the new man in.

OUT! Malinga bowls another slower one on the stumps, Paine goes for his premeditated scoop. The ball lobs towards the keeper who completes the catch. The bowler is appealing long and hard and the umpire gives it out lbw. Malinga has another wicket!
Another yorker from Malinga, Moises just about manages to keep it out and scampers across for a single.
Moises Henriques brings up his maiden T20I fifty!
FIFTY! Low yorker on the stumps, Moises clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. That is also fifty for him. He has played well.
Slower one on the stumps, dragged through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good over for Australia!
Fuller in length outside leg, played through mid on for a single.
Outside off on a length, punched toward point for a single by Paine.
The bowler is struggling with the cold.
FOUR! Paine is up and running! Slower one outside off, Paine sits back for it and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a beautiful boundary. Nice way to get off the mark!
Another length ball from Vikum, Moises drags it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Into the stands! Length ball from Vikum, Moises sits back waiting for it and dispatches it over square leg for a maximum. Superb strike from the all-rounder!
Vikum Sanjaya comes back into the attack.
Tim Paine has arrived at the crease.

OUT! Malinga special! A low dipping yorker on the stumps by Malinga. Faulkner fails to clip it and watches the bowler go up in an appeal. The umpire gives it out but replays show Faulkner had got an inside edge on that one. Malinga won't complain though. A timely wicket for the visitors.
Leading edge! Fuller in length on the stumps, Moises looks to clip it through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge towards point. A run taken.
Moises lunges into this clip and gets it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and the ball deflects towards covers but Moises is happy with the couple.
FOUR! Up and over! Moises knows Malinga is going to bowl length, he walks down the wicket, and adjusts to the bounce on this length ball and spanks it over extra cover for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Faulkner slaps it hard through point and by the time Asela returns the ball, Moises is back completing the second.
Outside off on a length, Faulkner taps it towards point and takes off for a quick single.
Lasith Malinga comes back into the attack.
James Faulkner has arrived at the crease.

OUT! Whattay catch! Fuller outside off, Turner looks to go over long off despite the presence of the fielder. He does not get the elevation on it. Siriwadana in the deep at long off, goes to his right, dives low and takes it inches off the ground. A superb outfield catch and Seekkuge is delighted. Sri Lanka need to take more wickets to stem the flow of runs here.
Shorter outside off, Henriques looks to cut but gets it off the outer half down towards third man. Two fielders hare after it but cannot prevent the third run.
Full toss outside off, Turner looks to bunt it but mistimes it through mid on for a single.
Another punch but this time it is behind point for another brace.
Shorter outside off, Turner punches it through covers and takes a couple of runs. The throw comes in at the striker's end but it is wide and the dive ensures Turner is in.
Floats it outside off, Moises looks to slog sweep but drags it through mid-wicket for a single off the inner half of the bat.
Seekkuge Prasanna brought back on for a bowl.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller delivery, outside off, Turner drives this through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, MH works it around to short fine leg. They run a single.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, Turner looks to cut but gets a bottom edge very near to his stumps and Henriques asks him to come for the single.
Ashton Turner comes out to bat.

OUT Catching practice! Length delivery, outside off, Head looks to guide it to third man but ends up edging it to Dickwella who takes an easy catch. The most happy person on the ground will be Munaweera who dropped him off the previous ball.

DROPPED! Back of a length delivery, around off, Head tries to pull and top edges. Dilshan Munaweera is at short third man and runs behind to grab it. However, he misjudges the catch and puts it down. They run a couple.
Nuwan Kulasekara called back on for a spell.

MH clips this through mid-wicket and asks Head to come for the second. The deep mid-wicket charges in and misfields, maybe didn't have his attention on the ball and the Australians complete the second easily.
Wide! Sanjaya bowls this way outside off, Henriques leaves it alone, umpire calls it a wide.

Good length delivery, around off, Head drives it towards Prasanna at mid off and urges MH to come for a single. The fielder dives and has a shy at the non striker's end but misses. Had it been a direct hit, Head could've been in trouble. They run a single.
MH flicks this short of a length delivery through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery, outside off, Head pushes it towards point and sets off for a single. Good running there!
Travis Head is the new man in.

OUT! The bowling change works for Sri Lanka as Sanjaya breaks the partnership. Length ball, around off, Klinger charges down the track looking to drive it over covers, doesn't connect and edges it to Dickwella who starts appealing straightaway. The bowler too joins and the umpire obliges.
Klinger cuts this length ball through point for a brace.
Vikum Sanjaya back on.

FOUR! DROPPED! Fuller delivery, around off, MH looks to go over long on and it goes very, very high in the air. Kapugedera hares across from long on, gets his hands to the ball but fluffs it. Ends up parrying it towards the fence for a boundary.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Klinger tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller delivery, around middle, Henriques flicks it through mid-wicket and runs one.
On a length, around off, Klinger camps back and cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Length delivery, around off, Henriques flicks it through square leg for a single.
Malinga initiates his second spell with a slower one outside off, Henriques looks to dab but pulls out seeing the bounce.
Lasith Malinga called back on for a bowl.
Flatter delivery, outside off, MH punches it through covers. They run a single.
Looped up delivery, around middle and leg, Henriques tries to pull but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Klinger eases this floated delivery through mid off for a single.
Klinger knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Clobbered! Tosses this one outside off, Klinger gets a stride forward and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, Klinger cuts it through point for a brace.
SIX! Fullish delivery, Henriques goes down on one knee and slams it over the square leg fence. Outstanding stroke this! Expensive over this, 15 off it!
Klinger clips this length delivery through mid-wicket and runs one.
Good length delivery, MH tries to pull but drags it through mid on for a single.
Length delivery, outside off, MH looks to work it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short and flatter, Klinger pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Length delivery around off, Klinger moves across, kneels and sweeps it over long for a maximum!
Shorter in length, Klinger drags his pull through mid-wicket for a single.
Cut through point for a couple of runs by Moises Henriques.
Flatter outside off, Moises goes back and slaps it towards mid off for a quick single.
Shorter outside off, spinning away, Moises looks to back away and pull it through but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly.
Spots Moises coming down, sprays it wide, Moises gets a bat on it to get it through covers for a couple of runs.
Shorter outside off, cut towards covers by Moises.
Almost! Hurls another slower one outside off, Moises looks to go over the infield but almost ends up chipping it to the bowler, who dives to his right but cannot get to the ball. A single taken.
Worked through mid on for a single.
On a length on off, worked towards mid on by the batsman. The bowler goes to his right and stops it in the process.
Floats it outside off, Klinger sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Klinger looks to loft it over covers but gets it off the toe end of the bat. They get a couple of runs.
Nudged through mid-wicket for a single. There is a slight confusion for the second and they eventually decide against it.
Shorter outside off, Klinger waits for it and looks to dab it past short third man for a single but is sent back in time.
Outside off, Moises gets across and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, cut through covers for a single by Klinger.
Short outside off, cut towards point by Klinger off his back foot. Good bowling this by the visitors.
Outside off, Klinger pushes it towards point from his crease coming forward.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Seekkuge Prasanna is introduced into the attack.
Outside off, pushed into covers by the batsman.
ALMOST! Bowls it outside off, Moises does not pick it and looks to dab it through third man. The ball goes off the inside edge and past the stumps for a single to fine leg.
Moises Henriques is the new man in.

OUT! Knocked him over! Slower one on the stumps by Asela, Dunk is ages early into his shot and plays all over it. The ball goes onto hit the timber and that's it for Ben Dunk. The show is over. Sri Lanka strike just at the right time!

NOT OUT! This one is bowled outside off and worked towards point by Klinger. Tharanga gets to the ball and fires it at the striker's end. Dunk dives as the keeper whips the bails off and appeals. It is referred upstairs but replays confirm Dunk was in.
Umpire goes up for a run out. Tharanga, the point fielder, throws it at the striker's end as Dickwella clips the bail off and Dunk seems to be in trouble.
On a length on off, Dunk punches it through covers for a single.
Shorter length outside off, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Asela Gunaratne comes into the attack.

SIX! Dunk makes most of the gamble! This one is fired on the pads but on a shorter length, Dunk does not miss out and smacks it with all his might, a solid whip over mid-wicket for a maximum. Huge over for Australia, 22 runs off it.
Flatter on middle, Dunk pushes it towards extra cover from the crease.
SIX! The Big Ben is back! This one is on the stumps, Dunk knew it was coming and sends it packing over the long off fence for a maximum. Clean, clean hitting from the southpaw here.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Served outside off, Dunk gets under it and lofts it cleanly over the extra fence for a maximum! What a strike!
Fuller on off, Ben smacks it hard toward mid off from his crease.
FOUR! JUST OVER! Short and wide outside off, Dunk goes after this one and gets it just over the backward point fielder for a boundary. Superb stoke!
Dilshan Munaweera called on for a bowl.
Klinger flicks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Dunk tries to pull this shortish delivery, but only manages to get an inside edge onto his thigh pad and the ball rolls towards short third man. They run a single.
FOUR! Outstanding stroke! Fuller delivery, outside off, Dunk clears his front leg and smacks it over covers for a boundary. Brute force there!
On a length, around off, Klinger defends it with soft hands towards the off side and urges Dunk to come for a single. The fielder charges in but fails to grab the ball and ends up giving the single.
Klinger comes down the track to whack this good length delivery over covers but gets beaten.
Length ball, outside off, Klinger drives it with superb control albeit to the cover fielder.
Dunk looks to tap this length delivery, but misses as the keeper collects it. Close shave that!
FOUR! Back of a length ball, around middle and leg, Dunk dances down the track and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for beautiful boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
On a length, around off, Klinger blocks towards point and sets off immediately. Good awareness from Dunk results in a comfortable single.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off, Klinger rocks back and cuts it marvelously through covers for a boundary. Magnificent shot, this!
Marginally ahead of a length, Klinger defends it towards covers. The fielder there has a shy at the non striker's end but it doesn't result in any overthrows.
Klinger comes down the track for this length delivery looking to go over covers, but inside edges it past the keeper. They run a brace.
WIDE! Bowls another delivery down the leg side. Umpire has no hesitation to call it a wide.
Dunk blocks this length delivery towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery, Dunk blocks it from well within the crease.
Ben Dunk walks in next.

OUT! Sri Lanka draw first blood! Length delivery, it is a slower one, Finch waits in his crease looking to work it away but ends up giving an easy catch back to the bowler. Sanjaya has read the pitch very well and it has paid dividends for the youngster.
This pitch has everything it seems. Bounce and swing both. Length delivery, which bounces and surprises Finch who defends it very late and it falls just short off the cover fielder.
Good length delivery, extracts some movement there off the pitch, as it goes away from Klinger as he looks to defend. He gets an outside edge which goes past point and they run a single.
Length delivery, swinging away, Klinger goes back and cuts it to the cover point fielder.
Vikum Sanjaya comes on for a bowl.
Length ball, going back in, Finch is cramped for room and punches it straight to point.
Good length ball, outside off, Finch defends it towards the covers.
FOUR! Length delivery, nipping back in, Finch stays in his crease and using his wrists flicks it through long leg for a boundary! Poor delivery!
Similar delivery, fifth stump line, Finch hops a touch and punches it towards deep point for a brace.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Finch cuts it uppishly through point. Good running there, they run a couple.
Length ball, outside off, Klinger pushes it towards off side and sets off immediately for a single.
WIDE! Length ball, going down the leg side, Kulasekara begins his spell with a loosener. Klinger looks to flick but it was out of his reach. Umpire signals it a wide.
Nuwan Kulasekara to bowl from the other end.
There comes the dipping yorker. Klinger was quite aware and digs it towards mid-wicket and runs one.
On a length, around leg, Finch looks to flick but misses and the ball raps his pads and goes towards the leg side. They run a leg bye.
FOUR! Room on offer and Finch punishes it! Length ball, swinging away, the batsman stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary. Gives no chance for the cover fielders whatsoever.
Slower and back of a length delivery, outside off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it back towards the bowler.
On a length, around leg, Klinger gets on his toes and tucks it through fine leg to get off the mark with a single.
Malinga starts off with a length ball, outside off, Klinger cuts it straight to covers.
The players are out in the middle. Hosts' openers Aaron Finch and Michael Klinger are at the centre. Upul Tharanga tosses the new ball to Lasith Malinga.
AUSTRALIA XI - Aaron Finch(c), Michael Klinger, Ben Dunk, Travis Head, Moises Henriques, Ashton Turner, Tim Paine(wk), James Faulkner, Pat Cummins, Andrew Tye, Jhye Richardson.

SRI LANKA XI - Niroshan Dickwella(wk), Upul Tharanga(c), Dilshan Munaweera, Kusal Mendis, Asela Gunaratne, Milinda Siriwardana, Chamara Kapugedera, Seekkuge Prasanna, Nuwan Kulasekara, Lasith Malinga, Vikum Sanjaya.

TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to field! A solitary change for the visitors, Kusal Mendis comes in for Lakshan Sandakan. For the hosts, Jhye Richardson to make his T20I debut, Billy Stanlake makes way for him. Ben Dunk comes into the side for Adam Zampa, a surprising call that.

The hosts on the other hand, will know they could have done much better. The fringe players will aim to use these games to put in a good performance to stake claim for a permanent place in the national side. It was raining earlier, but the covers are off and it seems like we won't have any delay. With so much at stake, expect another close contest!

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between Australia and Sri Lanka from the Simonds Stadium, Geelong, Victoria. This is the first international men's game at this venue, and it remains to be seen how the pitch plays. The visitors made heavy load of the chase in the first game but will be happy with the win. They will want to put in another good show and take the series against Australians.
